title: The 15 minute ORB that took $50k to $585 on NQ from 2016 to 2020 made 316% on the same rules from 2022 to 2026
author: person-person12
selftext:
A couple days ago I posted the plainest 15 minute opening range breakout on NQ, 5 minute candles, 1 contract, $50k account, and it went from $50k to $585 between May 2016 and July 2020. A comment under it said alpha decay, which would mean it worked once and stopped working. So I ran the exact same rules in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading) from January 2022 to the end of March 2026 to see which way it went.

**1,047 trades, 58% winners, profit factor 1.19, $50k to $207,905.** Thats after $10,470 of commission and slippage.

Year by year it reads like two different strategies. 2016 to 2020 had no green year at all, 2018 alone lost $19,040 and 2019 finished up $240. From 2022 on **every year was green**, 2023 was the weak one at +$8,055 and 2025 made $59,205.

The start is what I wouldnt skip. It opened January 2022 by dropping to $21,170 by February 16, a 58% hole in seven weeks, before the year turned around and finished +$29,615. Anybody running this live, or in an eval with a trailing drawdown, would have been done in February and never seen the 316%.

**-----**

The fair part, I havent run August 2020 to the end of 2021 yet, so I cant say where it flipped. Its one contract the whole way with no sizing changes, and NQ was trading around 4,400 when the first run started and around 16,300 when the second one did, so the opening ranges it trades are a lot bigger now and I havent tested whether thats what changed.
